_comment: Domains whose articles are skipped during automated discovery. Match is exact host OR '*.suffix.com' wildcard. Edit freely — script reads this fresh each run.
_selfDomainsComment: Our own site. Reddit posts linking to our uploads (case-summary PDFs etc.) are not news candidates — and PDFs break the AI extraction stage anyway.
_industryPromoComment: Add TTI-industry-friendly outlets here to reject them. Currently empty; populate as you spot patterns in the rejected log.
_urlPathPatternsComment: URL path substrings that indicate wire-syndicated content even when the host itself isn't a wire (e.g., manilatimes.net republishes globenewswire). Match is case-insensitive substring on the URL path. Applied after Google News URLs are resolved to canonical.
_allowlistComment: Domains here are NEVER rejected even if matched by a wildcard above. Use sparingly — e.g., if *.msn.com is blacklisted but a specific msn.com path you trust appears.
